verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a business banking platform, but the evidence pack never documents a bulk export of account data in open formats such as CSV or OFX. The closest evidence is accounting-software sync to QuickBooks and Xero and Plaid connectivity. Those are adjacent integration features, not a user-facing 'export everything and leave' capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
